topic: How to shorten the time it takes a baby to fall asleep at night: short ritual, low stimulation, matched wake window, a balanced meal before sleep
slide1_visual: Smiling illustrated mother (long brown hair, mauve top) holding a pink mug at a wooden table, warm orange-peach background with leaf shapes; no baby on the cover; no logo
art_style: soft 2D illustrated cartoon, one recurring mother character with a baby in a crib or cradle
palette: warm peach on the cover, then dusty mauve and purple overlay with cream text
text_layout: Centered white text over the illustration; the first line of each slide is a bold headline, following lines are a thin lighter weight; key phrases bolder; last slides use white pills for the CTA

structure.text_he_short: ברוב המקרים זה סימן שטקס השינה או סדר היום לא מותאמים
טקס שינה קצר ועקבי כ-10 עד 15 דקות
ארוחה מאוזנת לפני השינה (כתבו לי רשימה)
משפחות בליווי איתי דיווחו שהרדמות התקצרו לדקות בודדות
עקבו אחרי לעוד דברים שאף אחד לא יגיד לכם על השינה של התינוק שלכם

brand_presence: Logo top right on slides 2-8; large logo with services line and URL on the last slide; handle not visible
caption_summary: Medium: restates the message in a short paragraph (short ritual, matched wake window, soothing meal), no keyword in the caption, plus a medical disclaimer in a footnote
what_makes_it_work: A direct how-to question with four short fixes and a specific keyword CTA mid-carousel; the comment keyword drove 200 comments on 98 likes. The mother-and-baby cartoon keeps the same character so the series feels like one story.
lumebook_takeaway: A fixed cartoon parent character across slides plus a one-word comment CTA on the practical slide is a copyable format for a book brand.
